item: An unreadable custody-settings store is not read as unset
refs: PR #1995; queue:1255 (FIELD DEFECTS OUTSIDE THE WRITE PATH)
summary: load_settings() used to read a damaged row or a refused read (an exhausted pool) as no settings at all, so auto-log fell back to the legacy default ON and an operator who had switched it off could see an ingest logged. Now it says store_unreadable (shown by the settings route, never saved), auto-log reads OFF, and the ingest path queues the entry as owed instead of writing it under a guessed setting; the end-of-pass repayment waits until the setting reads ON again. A missing store keeps the legacy default.
